journey.name: paykit quoted usdt requests
journey.description: Two linked Bitkit wallets with Paykit and USDT enabled, sharing enabled by their owners, and a fresh BTC/USD rate. These request-creation and amount-screen checks need no funds and stop before payment review. Funded Arbitrum review, paid history, controlled rates and proof verification are manual tests in Docs/USDT-QA.md; a Bitcoin regtest balance does not fund USDT.

actions.action: Enable USDT in the introductory sheet or Settings, General, Payments before starting this flow.

Open a linked contact and create a USD payment request. Verify BTC and USD are the denomination choices and enabled receiving methods start selected. Verify Accept Payment In appears below expiry, with separate compact outlined Savings, Spending and USDT chips for available methods. Savings is orange, Spending is purple and USDT is teal; selected chips have a trailing X. Remove one available method and verify the other selections remain unchanged; tap it again to restore it.

On a comma-decimal device locale, enter 150,50 USD while creating a payment request. Verify the keypad, entered amount, request review and recipient row all show exactly 150,50 USD. Go back and verify the amount and denomination are preserved. On iOS with Classic Bitcoin display, repeat with a BTC amount and verify the keypad and amount use a dot and returning from review preserves the amount.
Return to the request amount editor, select USD and replace the amount with 10. Switch to BTC and back to USD four times without editing.
Verify the USD amount is still exactly 10 and each return to BTC shows the same satoshi amount.
Clear the USD input, then select BTC. Verify the amount is zero and Continue is disabled.

Select USD and enter 5 followed by the decimal separator without a fractional digit. Verify Continue is enabled. Continue and verify the request review shows 5,00 USD on a comma-decimal locale or 5.00 USD on a dot-decimal locale.

Deselect all receiving choices and verify sending the request is disabled. Select only USDT, enter 150,50 USD on the comma-decimal locale, select an expiry and send the request. Verify the sent screen, outgoing request card and request details all show 150,50 USD. Reopen the amount editor on a new request and verify typed trailing zeros are preserved.

On the payer using the same comma-decimal locale, verify the incoming request card and details show 150,50 USD. Open the request and verify Amount represents exactly 150.50 USDT with USDT selected as the payment method, the amount cannot be edited, and no Bitcoin funding source is offered. Close without continuing to review.

Reopen the unpaid USDT request and wait for its Amount screen. Tap Back and verify the send sheet closes without showing a Bitcoin confirmation or a Swipe To Pay control. Reopen the same request and verify its amount and USDT payment method are preserved. Close without paying.

Create a USD request accepting Bitcoin and USDT whose quoted USDT amount is greater than the payer's USDT balance. On the payer, open the request and verify Bitcoin starts selected; USDT remains available for manual selection. Close without continuing. Repeat with a request whose quoted USDT amount is covered by that balance and verify USDT starts selected. This initial choice covers the requested amount only; fees are checked when preparing payment.

Create a BTC request accepting Savings and USDT. If Spending is available, deselect it before sending. On the payer's Amount screen, verify Savings and USDT are available but Spending is not. Switch between the accepted sources and verify the displayed amount preserves the request's quoted value and cannot be edited. Close without continuing.

Create a USD subscription for 150,50 on a comma-decimal locale. Verify the amount review shows 150,50 USD and editing preserves that amount. Verify Accepted Payments appears below frequency, with USDT selected and any available Savings and Spending chips unselected. Verify the description and icon controls are side by side. Propose it to the linked contact. On the payer, verify the subscription card and details show 150,50 USD, then review its recurrence and USDT-only payment method. Verify the subscription swipe uses USDT teal, then close before subscribing.

Create a BTC subscription for 12,345 sats and verify available Savings and Spending chips start selected and USDT is unselected. Deselect each selected Bitcoin chip and verify Choose Recipient is disabled when none remain. Select Savings (id "SubscriptionAccept-savings"), then USDT (id "SubscriptionAccept-usdt"); verify the amount converts to USD and only USDT is selected. Select Savings again; verify the amount returns to exactly 12,345 sats and only Savings is selected. If Spending is available, select it (id "SubscriptionAccept-spending") and verify both Bitcoin rails can be selected together, with USDT still unselected.

Repeat the subscription USDT and Savings switches four times without editing. Verify every return to Bitcoin shows exactly 12,345 sats and USDT is never selected with a Bitcoin rail. Edit the amount to 10 USD, repeat the switches and verify every return to USDT shows exactly 10 USD. Select Savings only and propose to the linked contact. On the payer, verify the proposal offers Savings but not Spending or USDT, then close before subscribing.

Open a linked USDT-only contact that has published a private payment list. Verify the amount screen offers only USDT, enter 0.01, verify the USDT balance is labeled AVAILABLE rather than AVAILABLE (SPENDING), then close without continuing to review.
